app.title: Floor Plan Studio
app.subtitle: Set your plot size, add rooms, drag them into place, save your plans and export to PDF.
app.meta_description: Drag-and-drop floor plan generator with PDF export.

sidebar.plot_hint: The canvas is drawn to this size. Rooms must fit inside it.
sidebar.empty_rooms: No rooms yet. Add one above to get started.
sidebar.templates_hint: Start from a ready-made layout that stretches to fit your plot.

actions.confirm_clear: Remove every room from the plan?
actions.add_on_wall: Add a door, window or vent on this wall

canvas.empty_hint: Use the panel on the left to add rooms. Drag them to arrange your plan.
canvas.scale_hint: Grid: 1 square = {{size}} · Snap: {{snap}} or nearest wall

messages.no_space: No free space left for a room of that size
messages.rotate_blocked: Not enough space to rotate this room
messages.plot_too_small: Some rooms would fall outside that plot. Move them first or pick a bigger size.
messages.export_error: Couldn't export the PDF. Please try again.
messages.export_empty: Add at least one room before exporting
messages.template_too_small: Your plot is too small for this template
messages.no_doors_placed: No walls long enough for doors were found
messages.confirm_auto_doors: Replace all existing doors with automatically placed ones?
messages.swap_blocked: {{a}} and {{b}} can't swap — one doesn't fit in the other's spot
messages.no_windows_placed: No free outside walls found for windows
messages.confirm_auto_windows: Replace all existing windows with automatically placed ones?
messages.confirm_auto_both: Replace all existing doors, windows and vents with automatically placed ones?
messages.room_update_blocked: That size doesn't fit here — it would overlap another room or leave the plot
messages.no_vents_placed: No outside walls free for vents (bathrooms, kitchens and garages get them)
messages.confirm_auto_vents: Replace all existing vents with automatically placed ones?

templates.replace_body: This removes the {{count}} rooms on the canvas and loads the template.

family_3bed.name: Family 3-bedroom
family_3bed.description: Garage, living and dining zone, with a hallway leading to three bedrooms.

garden_home.name: Garden home
garden_home.description: Front garden, open living, kitchen and TV lounge, two bedrooms and stairs.

doors.title: Doors
doors.select_hint: Select a room on the canvas to add or edit its doors, windows and vents.
doors.empty: No doors on this room yet.
doors.drag_hint: Tip: drag a door, window or vent on the canvas to slide it along a wall or move it to another wall.

windows.title: Windows
windows.empty: No windows on this room yet.

edit_room.title: Edit room
edit_room.select_hint: Select a room on the canvas or in the list to edit it.

vents.title: Vents
vents.empty: No vents on this room yet.

view3d.hint: Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · right-drag to pan · click a floor to select
view3d.empty: Add some rooms to see them in 3D.

tour.hint_unlocked: Click the view (or drag) to look around · W A S D or arrow keys to move · hold Shift to run
tour.hint_locked: Move the mouse to look · W A S D to move · Shift to run · Esc to free the mouse
tour.finished: Tour complete — you've seen every room you can reach through a door.
tour.unreachable_one: {{count}} room has no door leading to it, so the tour skips it.
tour.unreachable_other: {{count}} rooms have no door leading to them, so the tour skips them.

plans.autosave_hint: Your work is autosaved in this browser, so it's still here if you refresh. Use Save to keep it in My plans.
plans.empty: No saved plans yet. Use Save to keep the current plan here.
plans.storage_note: Plans are kept in this browser only. Download a plan file to back one up or move it to another device.
plans.unsaved_body: The current plan has changes that aren't saved. They'll be lost.
plans.storage_failed: Your browser isn't letting this app save (storage is full or blocked). Download a plan file to keep your work.

errors.not_json: That file couldn't be read as a plan file.
errors.not_plan: That file isn't a Floor Plan Studio plan.
errors.newer_version: That plan was made with a newer version of the app.
errors.invalid: That plan file is damaged or incomplete.
